node.title: E22 kernel-invariance full-fiber criterion
node.statement: In a cyclic E22 domain, for any dyadic divisor M, a subset is a union of full fibers of x -> x^M if and only if it is invariant under multiplication by the M-th-root kernel of that map.
node.attack_surface: finite cyclic-group quotient criterion for unions of cosets
node.falsifier: a subset invariant under the quotient-map kernel that is not a union of fibers, or a union of fibers that is not kernel-invariant
